cases.name: empty
cases.sql: select "s0"."id" from "shipping_option" as "s0" inner join "service_zone" as "s1" on "s0"."service_zone_id" = "s1"."id" where "s1"."fulfillment_set_id" in ($1)

cases.name: country
cases.sql: select "s0"."id" from "shipping_option" as "s0" inner join "service_zone" as "s1" on "s0"."service_zone_id" = "s1"."id" left join "geo_zone" as "g2" on "s1"."id" = "g2"."service_zone_id" where "s1"."fulfillment_set_id" in ($1) and "g2"."type" = $2 and "g2"."country_code" = $3

cases.name: postal-without-ancestors
cases.sql: select "s0"."id" from "shipping_option" as "s0" inner join "service_zone" as "s1" on "s0"."service_zone_id" = "s1"."id" left join "geo_zone" as "g2" on "s1"."id" = "g2"."service_zone_id" where "s1"."fulfillment_set_id" in ($1) and (("g2"."type" = $2 and "g2"."country_code" = $3 and "g2"."postal_expression" = $4) or ("g2"."type" = $5 and "g2"."country_code" = $6))

cases.name: full-address
cases.sql: select "s0"."id" from "shipping_option" as "s0" inner join "service_zone" as "s1" on "s0"."service_zone_id" = "s1"."id" left join "geo_zone" as "g2" on "s1"."id" = "g2"."service_zone_id" where "s1"."fulfillment_set_id" in ($1) and (("g2"."type" = $2 and "g2"."country_code" = $3 and "g2"."province_code" = $4 and "g2"."city" = $5 and "g2"."postal_expression" = $6) or ("g2"."type" = $7 and "g2"."country_code" = $8 and "g2"."province_code" = $9 and "g2"."city" = $10) or ("g2"."type" = $11 and "g2"."country_code" = $12 and "g2"."province_code" = $13) or ("g2"."type" = $14 and "g2"."country_code" = $15))

cases.name: case-preserved
cases.sql: select "s0"."id" from "shipping_option" as "s0" inner join "service_zone" as "s1" on "s0"."service_zone_id" = "s1"."id" left join "geo_zone" as "g2" on "s1"."id" = "g2"."service_zone_id" where "s1"."fulfillment_set_id" in ($1) and (("g2"."type" = $2 and "g2"."country_code" = $3 and "g2"."postal_expression" = $4) or ("g2"."type" = $5 and "g2"."country_code" = $6))
